expectedIssues: Bottom nav labels are cut off below the screen edge and a black horizontal bar overlaps the icons
reportedIssues: The iOS home indicator (horizontal black bar) is rendered on top of the bottom navigation bar, overlapping and obscuring the search and bookmark/order icons, making the tab bar look broken and potentially hindering taps.

Bottom navigation icons (home, search, orders, profile) have no text labels and no visible active-state indicator beyond color, which can make their purpose ambiguous, especially for the overlapped search and bookmark icons.

The heart (favorite) button on the dark restaurant cards uses a dark translucent circle that blends into the dark image background, reducing its visibility compared to the same button on lighter images.

expected.reasoning: Reported issue 0 describes the black home-indicator bar overlapping and obscuring the bottom navigation icons.
